name.zh: 安息帝国（阿萨息斯王朝）

summary.en: The Arsacid dynasty, from the Parni of north-eastern Iran, built an empire from the Euphrates to the borders of India. Its decentralised realm repeatedly fought Rome over Armenia and Mesopotamia until Ardashir I overthrew it in 224.
summary.zh: 源自伊朗东北部帕尔尼部落的阿萨息斯王朝建立了从幼发拉底河延伸到印度边境的帝国。这个分权的国家为争夺亚美尼亚和美索不达米亚多次与罗马交战，224年被阿尔达希尔一世推翻。

note: Reign dates of Parthian kings are reconstructed largely from coins and are approximate.

name.zh: 亚美尼亚王国（阿萨息斯王朝）

capital.zh: 阿尔塔沙特，后为瓦加尔沙帕特、德温

summary.en: A branch of the Parthian Arsacids ruled Armenia, usually as a buffer between Rome and Iran, until the Sasanians abolished the monarchy in 428. Under Tiridates III Armenia adopted Christianity, and in this era the Armenian alphabet was created.
summary.zh: 安息阿萨息斯家族的一支统治亚美尼亚，通常作为罗马与伊朗之间的缓冲国，直至428年萨珊王朝废除其王权。梯里达底三世时亚美尼亚皈依基督教，亚美尼亚字母也创制于这一时期。

sources.title: R. G. Hovannisian (ed.), The Armenian People from Ancient to Modern Times, vol. 1 (1997)

note: Start date disputed: 12 CE counts the Parthian prince Vonones I; Encyclopaedia Iranica dates the dynasty proper from Tiridates I (installed 52/53, recognised 63, crowned by Nero 66; Wikidata 66). Arsacid rule was intermittent before 66; reign dates are approximate.

summary.en: Under Queen Zenobia, ruling for her son Vaballathus, the caravan city of Palmyra broke away from a crisis-ridden Rome and seized Egypt and much of Anatolia. Emperor Aurelian defeated her in 272 and sacked Palmyra after a revolt in 273.
summary.zh: 在为儿子瓦巴拉图斯摄政的芝诺比阿女王领导下，商队城市帕尔米拉脱离危机中的罗马，夺取埃及和安纳托利亚大部。272年奥勒良皇帝击败她，273年平定叛乱后洗劫帕尔米拉。

name.zh: 奥登纳图斯（帕尔米拉国王）

summary.en: The last pre-Islamic Iranian empire, founded by Ardashir I, ruled from Mesopotamia to Central Asia. A Zoroastrian monarchy with a centralised administration, it rivalled Rome and Byzantium for four centuries before falling to the Arab conquests; Yazdegerd III, the last shah, died in 651.
summary.zh: 阿尔达希尔一世建立的最后一个前伊斯兰伊朗帝国，疆域从美索不达米亚延伸到中亚。这个奉琐罗亚斯德教、行政集中的君主国与罗马和拜占庭抗衡四百年，终亡于阿拉伯征服；末代君主伊嗣俟三世于651年身亡。

summary.en: The caliphate of the first four successors of Muhammad, called "rightly guided" (Rashidun) by Sunni Muslims. Its armies conquered Syria, Iraq, Egypt and Iran, while disputes over the succession led to the first civil war (656–661).
summary.zh: 穆罕默德之后前四位继承者的哈里发国，逊尼派称之为“正统”。其军队征服叙利亚、伊拉克、埃及和伊朗，而继承权之争导致了第一次内战（656—661年）。

sources.title: W. Madelung, The Succession to Muhammad (1997)

summary.en: The first hereditary caliphate, ruled from Damascus by the Umayyad clan of Quraysh. It extended Muslim rule from Iberia to the Indus, made Arabic the language of administration and built the Dome of the Rock, before falling to the Abbasid revolution.
summary.zh: 首个世袭哈里发国，由古莱什部落的倭马亚家族以大马士革为都统治。它将穆斯林统治从伊比利亚扩展到印度河，以阿拉伯语为行政语言并修建圆顶清真寺，最终被阿拔斯革命推翻。

sources.title: H. Kennedy, The Prophet and the Age of the Caliphates (3rd ed., 2016)

summary.en: Descendants of the Prophet's uncle al-Abbas, the Abbasids moved the caliphate's centre to Iraq and founded Baghdad. Their early centuries saw a flowering of science and letters; real power later passed to Buyid and Seljuk sultans, and the Mongols ended the Baghdad caliphate in 1258.
summary.zh: 先知叔父阿拔斯的后裔将哈里发国的中心移至伊拉克并建立巴格达。王朝前期科学与文学繁荣；后来实权落入布韦希和塞尔柱苏丹之手，1258年蒙古人终结了巴格达的哈里发政权。

note: A line of Abbasid shadow caliphs continued under the Mamluks in Cairo until 1517.

capital.zh: 内沙布尔、剌夷，后为伊斯法罕

summary.en: An Oghuz Turkic dynasty that conquered Iran, entered Baghdad in 1055 as protector of the Abbasid caliph and defeated Byzantium at Manzikert. Under the vizier Nizam al-Mulk it sponsored madrasas and a Sunni revival; it fragmented after 1092, and the last sultan in Iraq fell in 1194.
summary.zh: 乌古斯突厥王朝，征服伊朗，1055年以阿拔斯哈里发保护者身份进入巴格达，并在曼齐刻尔特击败拜占庭。在宰相尼扎姆·穆勒克主持下兴办经学院、推动逊尼派复兴；1092年后分裂，1194年伊拉克的末代苏丹败亡。

sources.title: A. C. S. Peacock, The Great Seljuk Empire (2015)

summary.en: A Seljuk branch that ruled much of Anatolia after Manzikert, first from Nicaea and from 1097 from Konya. Its 13th-century peak saw caravanserais and Persianate culture flourish; after defeat by the Mongols at Köse Dağ in 1243 it became an Ilkhanid vassal and dissolved by c. 1307.
summary.zh: 塞尔柱的一支，曼齐刻尔特之战后统治安纳托利亚大部，先都尼西亚，1097年起都科尼亚。13世纪鼎盛时商队客栈和波斯化文化繁荣；1243年在克塞山败于蒙古后沦为伊利汗国附庸，约1307年解体。

sources.title: C. Cahen, The Formation of Turkey (2001)

capital.zh: 库塔伊西，1122年起为第比利斯

summary.en: Unified under Bagrat III in 1008, the Bagrationi kingdom became the leading Christian power of the Caucasus. Its golden age under David IV and Queen Tamar was ended by Khwarazmian and Mongol invasions; after a revival under George V it split into rival kingdoms in the late 15th century.
summary.zh: 1008年在巴格拉特三世治下统一，巴格拉季昂尼王朝的王国成为高加索首要的基督教强国。大卫四世和塔玛尔女王的黄金时代被花剌子模和蒙古入侵终结；经格奥尔基五世复兴后，15世纪末分裂为数个对立王国。

sources.title: D. Rayfield, Edge of Empires: A History of Georgia (2012)

note: Wikidata gives 1466 as the end; most accounts date the final partition to 1490–1493, used here.

summary.en: A crusader state founded after the capture of Jerusalem in 1099. After Saladin's victory at Hattin in 1187 it lost Jerusalem and survived as a coastal kingdom centred on Acre until the Mamluks took Acre in 1291.
summary.zh: 1099年攻占耶路撒冷后建立的十字军国家。1187年萨拉丁在哈丁获胜后失去耶路撒冷，此后以阿卡为中心作为沿海王国延续，直到1291年阿卡被马穆鲁克攻陷。

name.zh: 布永的戈弗雷（圣墓守护者）

sources.title: S. Runciman, A History of the Crusades (1951–54)

note: Jerusalem itself was briefly held again in 1229–1244.

name.zh: 奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国

summary.en: Founded by Armenian lords who settled in Cilicia after the Seljuk conquest of Greater Armenia, it became a kingdom in 1198. Allied with the crusaders and later the Mongols, it was a centre of Armenian culture until the Mamluks captured Sis in 1375.
summary.zh: 塞尔柱征服大亚美尼亚后，迁居奇里乞亚的亚美尼亚贵族建立此国，1198年升格为王国。它先后与十字军和蒙古结盟，是亚美尼亚文化中心，直至1375年马穆鲁克攻陷都城西斯。

sources.title: R. G. Hovannisian (ed.), The Armenian People from Ancient to Modern Times, vol. 1 (1997)

note: Principality from 1080, kingdom from 1198.

summary.en: Kurdish dynasty founded by Saladin, who ended the Fatimid caliphate in Egypt in 1171 and united Egypt and Syria. It recaptured Jerusalem from the crusaders in 1187; after 1250 power in Egypt passed to the Mamluks, though Ayyubid princes held Hama until 1341.
summary.zh: 萨拉丁建立的库尔德王朝。他于1171年终结埃及的法蒂玛哈里发政权，统一埃及和叙利亚，1187年从十字军手中收复耶路撒冷；1250年后埃及政权落入马穆鲁克之手，但阿尤布家族在哈马的支系延续到1341年。

sources.title: R. S. Humphreys, From Saladin to the Mongols (1977)

note: Capital point shown at Damascus, the dynasty's Syrian seat; Cairo was the main seat of the sultans of Egypt.

capital.zh: 马拉盖、大不里士，后为苏丹尼耶

summary.en: Mongol khanate founded by Hulagu in Iran and Iraq. Its rulers converted to Islam under Ghazan in 1295 and patronised Persian historiography, science and art, notably Rashid al-Din's universal history; the state disintegrated after Abu Sa'id died without an heir in 1335.
summary.zh: 旭烈兀在伊朗和伊拉克建立的蒙古汗国。1295年合赞汗时皈依伊斯兰教，汗廷赞助波斯史学、科学和艺术，尤以拉施特的《史集》著称；1335年不赛因无嗣而终后国家瓦解。

sources.title: P. Jackson, The Mongols and the Islamic World (2017)

capital.zh: 索于特、布尔萨、埃迪尔内；1453年起为君士坦丁堡/伊斯坦布尔

summary.en: From a small frontier principality in north-western Anatolia, the Ottoman dynasty built an empire spanning south-east Europe, Anatolia, the Arab lands and North Africa, with Constantinople as capital from 1453. After 19th-century reforms and territorial losses it collapsed after World War I; the sultanate was abolished in 1922.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼王朝从安纳托利亚西北部的边境小公国起家，建立起横跨东南欧、安纳托利亚、阿拉伯地区和北非的帝国，1453年起以君士坦丁堡为都。经历19世纪改革与领土丧失后，帝国在一战后崩溃，苏丹制于1922年被废除。

sources.title: C. Finkel, Osman's Dream: The History of the Ottoman Empire (2005)

note: Osman I died c. 1323/24 (Wikidata gives 1326).

capital.zh: 大不里士、加兹温，1598年起为伊斯法罕

summary.en: Founded by Shah Ismail I from a Sufi order of Ardabil, the Safavid state made Twelver Shi'ism Iran's official religion and fought the Ottomans for two centuries. It peaked under Abbas I at Isfahan; the Afghan capture of Isfahan in 1722 ended effective Safavid rule.
summary.zh: 由阿尔达比勒苏非教团出身的伊斯玛仪一世建立，萨法维王朝定十二伊玛目什叶派为伊朗国教，与奥斯曼争战两百年。阿拔斯一世在伊斯法罕时达到鼎盛；1722年阿富汗人攻陷伊斯法罕，萨法维的实际统治告终。

note: Nominal Safavid shahs reigned under Nader's control until 1736.

summary.en: Dynasty founded by Nader Shah, a Turkmen of the Afshar tribe who expelled the Afghans and Ottomans and was crowned on the Mughan plain in 1736. His campaigns reached Delhi, but after his assassination in 1747 the realm fragmented and his successors held only Khorasan until 1796.
summary.zh: 阿夫沙尔部落的土库曼人纳迪尔沙驱逐阿富汗人和奥斯曼人，1736年在穆甘草原加冕，建立此王朝。其征战远及德里，但1747年他遇刺后国家分裂，继承者仅保有呼罗珊至1796年。

sources.title: M. Axworthy, The Sword of Persia (2006)

note: Shahrukh's rule over Khorasan was interrupted and largely nominal.

summary.en: Turkmen dynasty founded by Agha Mohammad Khan, who made Tehran the capital and reunified Iran. In the 19th century it lost the Caucasus to Russia and faced growing British and Russian influence; the Constitutional Revolution limited royal power, and Reza Khan deposed the last shah in 1925.
summary.zh: 阿迦·穆罕默德汗建立的土库曼王朝，定都德黑兰并重新统一伊朗。19世纪将高加索领土割让给俄国，并受到英俄日益加深的影响；立宪革命限制了王权，1925年礼萨汗废黜末代国王。

sources.title: A. Amanat, Iran: A Modern History (2017)

note: Agha Mohammad Khan dominated Iran from 1789 but was crowned only in 1796.

summary.en: Founded by army officer Reza Khan, proclaimed shah in 1925, who pursued centralisation, secularisation and modernisation. His son Mohammad Reza Shah, restored to full power by the 1953 coup, launched the White Revolution reforms but was overthrown in the revolution of 1978–79.
summary.zh: 军官礼萨汗于1925年称王建立，推行中央集权、世俗化和现代化。其子穆罕默德-礼萨·沙借1953年政变恢复全部权力，推行“白色革命”改革，但在1978—1979年革命中被推翻。

sources.title: E. Abrahamian, A History of Modern Iran (2008)

summary.en: Republic proclaimed in 1923 from the Anatolian core of the Ottoman Empire after the War of Independence. Atatürk's reforms created a secular state with a Latin alphabet and new civil code; multi-party politics began in 1946, and Turkey joined NATO in 1952.
summary.zh: 独立战争后于1923年在奥斯曼帝国的安纳托利亚核心地区宣布成立的共和国。阿塔图尔克的改革建立了世俗国家，采用拉丁字母和新民法；1946年开始多党政治，1952年加入北约。

name.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

name.en: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (prime minister, then president)
name.zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（总理，后任总统）

sources.title: E.-J. Zürcher, Turkey: A Modern History (4th ed., 2017)

note: "to" 2025 marks the end of the atlas period; the state continues.

summary.en: Established by referendum after the 1979 revolution, the Islamic Republic combines elected institutions with clerical guardianship under a Supreme Leader. It fought the 1980–1988 war with Iraq and has since been shaped by regional rivalries, nuclear disputes and international sanctions.
summary.zh: 1979年革命后经公民投票建立，伊斯兰共和国将民选机构与最高领袖领导下的教法学家监护制度相结合。它经历了1980—1988年两伊战争，此后受到地区对抗、核问题争端和国际制裁的深刻影响。

name.zh: 鲁霍拉·霍梅尼（最高领袖）
阿里·哈梅内伊（最高领袖）

sources.title: Axios: Iranian state media confirms Supreme Leader Khamenei is dead (28 February 2026)

note: "to" 2025 marks the end of the atlas period. Khamenei's end year 2026: he was killed in a US–Israeli strike on Tehran on 28 February 2026 (confirmed by Iranian state media; AP, Axios).

summary.en: Kingdom proclaimed by Abdulaziz ibn Saud in 1932 after three decades of conquest across central Arabia and the Hejaz. As custodian of Mecca and Medina and, from 1938, a major oil producer, it became one of the most influential states of the Middle East; it remains an absolute monarchy.
summary.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·伊本·沙特经三十年征战统一阿拉伯半岛中部和汉志后，于1932年宣布成立王国。作为麦加和麦地那的守护者以及1938年后的主要产油国，它成为中东最具影响力的国家之一，至今仍为君主专制国家。

name.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹（伊本·沙特）

sources.title: M. al-Rasheed, A History of Saudi Arabia (2nd ed., 2010)

note: Wikidata's inception (1727) refers to the first Saudi state (Emirate of Diriyah); this record covers the kingdom from 1932. "to" 2025 marks the end of the atlas period.

summary.en: An Arab kingdom of caravan traders that controlled the incense routes between Arabia and the Mediterranean from its rock-cut capital at Petra. It became a Roman client and was annexed by Trajan in 106 as the province of Arabia Petraea.
summary.zh: 由阿拉伯商队贸易者建立的王国，以岩凿城市佩特拉为都，控制阿拉伯半岛与地中海之间的香料商路。后成为罗马附庸，106年被图拉真吞并为阿拉伯佩特拉行省。

note: The kingdom’s start is conventionally dated to Aretas I (attested c. 168 BCE); reigns are reconstructed from coins and inscriptions.

summary.en: The dominant kingdom of South Arabia in late antiquity. Its kings absorbed Saba and Hadramawt by about 300, adopted a Jewish-leaning monotheism in the late fourth century, and fell to an Aksumite invasion after the persecution of the Christians of Najran.
summary.zh: 古代晚期南阿拉伯的主导王国。约300年前后兼并萨巴和哈德拉毛，四世纪末王室转向犹太教式的一神信仰；在纳季兰基督徒遭迫害后，被阿克苏姆入侵所灭。

name.zh: 优素福·阿萨尔（祖·努瓦斯）

sources.title: C. J. Robin, "Himyar, Aksum, and Arabia Deserta in Late Antiquity", in Arabs and Empires before Islam (2015)

note: Himyarite regnal dates are approximate and come from dated inscriptions. After 525 Aksumite viceroys (notably Abraha) ruled Yemen until the Persian conquest c. 570.

summary.en: An Arab Christian-influenced kingdom centred on al-Hira on the lower Euphrates, which served the Sasanians as a buffer and ally against Rome and its Ghassanid clients. Khosrow II abolished it in 602, removing a shield that the Arab armies later crossed.
summary.zh: 以幼发拉底河下游希拉为中心的阿拉伯王国，深受基督教影响，作为萨珊王朝的缓冲国和盟友对抗罗马及其伽珊附庸。602年霍斯劳二世废除该王国，拆除了这道屏障，后来的阿拉伯军队正是由此进入伊拉克。

name.zh: 伊姆鲁勒-盖斯·本·阿慕尔

sources.title: G. Fisher, Between Empires: Arabs, Romans, and Sasanians in Late Antiquity (2011)

note: The founding date (traditionally c. 268 under ʿAmr ibn ʿAdī) is traditional.

summary.en: An Arab Christian dynasty settled in Syria that became Rome’s chief federates on the desert frontier. Justinian made al-Harith ibn Jabalah supreme phylarch around 529; the confederation dissolved in the Muslim conquest, its last king Jabalah fighting at Yarmouk.
summary.zh: 定居叙利亚的阿拉伯基督教王朝，成为罗马在沙漠边境最重要的同盟部族。约529年查士丁尼任命哈里斯·本·贾巴拉为最高部族首领；该联盟在穆斯林征服中瓦解，末代国王贾巴拉曾参与雅尔穆克战役。

sources.title: I. Shahîd, Byzantium and the Arabs in the Sixth Century (1995–2010)

note: Ghassanid arrival in Syria (3rd century) is traditional; the federate kingdom proper dates from c. 502–529.

capital.zh: 姆茨赫塔，后迁第比利斯

summary.en: The eastern Georgian kingdom of Kartli, poised between Rome and Iran. King Mirian III adopted Christianity in the 330s, and Vakhtang I Gorgasali is remembered as the founder of Tbilisi. The Sasanians abolished the monarchy around 580.
summary.zh: 东格鲁吉亚的卡特利王国，夹处罗马与伊朗之间。米里安三世于330年代皈依基督教，瓦赫坦一世·戈尔加萨利被视为第比利斯的奠基者。约580年萨珊王朝废除其王权。

name.zh: 瓦赫坦一世·戈尔加萨利

sources.title: S. H. Rapp, The Sasanian World through Georgian Eyes (2014)

note: Early dates follow the medieval Georgian chronicles (Kartlis Tskhovreba) and are partly traditional; Vakhtang’s reign is variously given as 447–522 or 449–502.

summary.en: A restored Armenian kingdom recognised by both the Abbasid caliph and the Byzantine emperor when Ashot I was crowned in 884/885. Its capital Ani became the "city of 1,001 churches"; Byzantium annexed the kingdom in 1045, shortly before the Seljuk conquest.
summary.zh: 884/885年阿硕特一世加冕，得到阿拔斯哈里发和拜占庭皇帝的共同承认，亚美尼亚王国由此复兴。其首都阿尼号称“千零一座教堂之城”；1045年拜占庭吞并该王国，不久塞尔柱人便攻占了这一地区。

sources.title: R. G. Hovannisian (ed.), The Armenian People from Ancient to Modern Times, vol. 1 (1997)

summary.en: An Arab Shi'i dynasty of the Taghlib tribe that ruled Mosul and Aleppo. Sayf al-Dawla’s court at Aleppo hosted al-Mutanabbi and al-Farabi while he waged annual border wars against Byzantium.
summary.zh: 出自塔格利卜部落的阿拉伯什叶派王朝，统治摩苏尔和阿勒颇。赛福·道莱在阿勒颇的宫廷庇护了穆太奈比和法拉比，同时年年与拜占庭进行边境战争。

capital.zh: 设拉子（另有雷伊与巴格达）

summary.en: Three Daylamite brothers from the Caspian highlands carved out a Shi'i confederation in western Iran and took Baghdad in 945, keeping the Abbasid caliphs as figureheads. Under 'Adud al-Dawla it was the leading power of the Islamic east until the Seljuks displaced it.
summary.zh: 来自里海山地的三位德莱木兄弟在伊朗西部建立什叶派联合政权，945年攻入巴格达，把阿拔斯哈里发当作傀儡。阿杜德·道莱在位时它是伊斯兰东方最强的政权，后被塞尔柱人取代。

sources.title: H. Kennedy, The Prophet and the Age of the Caliphates (3rd ed., 2016)

summary.en: A Turkish atabeg dynasty founded by Imad al-Din Zengi, governor of Mosul. Zengi’s capture of Edessa in 1144 and his son Nur al-Din’s union of Syria under the banner of jihad set the stage for Saladin, who was a Zengid officer.
summary.zh: 由摩苏尔总督伊马德丁·赞吉建立的突厥阿塔贝格王朝。赞吉于1144年攻克埃德萨，其子努尔丁以圣战为号召统一叙利亚，为萨拉丁的崛起铺平道路；萨拉丁本人原是赞吉王朝的将领。

name.zh: 赛福丁·加齐一世（摩苏尔）
伊兹丁·马苏德一世（摩苏尔）

sources.title: C. Hillenbrand, The Crusades: Islamic Perspectives (1999)

note: The main Mosul line ended when Badr al-Din Luʾluʾ took power (1233); minor branches lasted to c. 1250.

name.zh: 尼扎里伊斯玛仪派国家（阿拉穆特）

summary.en: A scattered state of mountain fortresses in Iran and Syria founded when Hasan-i Sabbah seized Alamut in 1090. Its opponents called its followers hashishiyya ("Assassins") for their targeted killings of enemies; Hulagu’s Mongols took Alamut and most of its strongholds in 1256, though Gerdkuh held out until 1270.
summary.zh: 1090年哈桑·沙巴夺取阿拉穆特后建立的国家，由分布在伊朗和叙利亚山区的诸多要塞组成。敌人因其针对政敌的暗杀而称之为“哈希什派”（“阿萨辛派”）；1256年旭烈兀率蒙古军攻陷阿拉穆特及大部分要塞，但吉尔德库赫堡一直坚守到1270年。

sources.title: F. Daftary, The Assassin Legends (1994) and The Ismāʿīlīs (2nd ed., 2007)

note: Syrian Nizari castles survived until the Mamluk sultan Baybars took them in 1270–73.

summary.en: A Mongol successor dynasty that rose from the break-up of the Ilkhanate and ruled Iraq and Azerbaijan. Its Baghdad and Tabriz courts were major centres of Persian painting until Timur’s invasions and the Qara Qoyunlu ended its power.
summary.zh: 伊利汗国瓦解后兴起的蒙古系继承王朝，统治伊拉克和阿塞拜疆。其巴格达与大不里士宫廷是波斯细密画的重要中心，后因帖木儿入侵和黑羊王朝的崛起而衰亡。

sources.title: C. E. Bosworth, The New Islamic Dynasties (1996)

summary.en: The "Black Sheep" Turkmen confederation of eastern Anatolia and Azerbaijan. Qara Yusuf survived Timur and took Tabriz; Jahan Shah extended its rule over most of Iran before he was killed by his Aq Qoyunlu rival Uzun Hasan in 1467.
summary.zh: “黑羊”土库曼部落联盟，兴起于安纳托利亚东部和阿塞拜疆。卡拉·优素福在帖木儿的打击下幸存并夺取大不里士；贾汉·沙把统治扩展到伊朗大部，1467年被白羊王朝对手乌宗·哈桑所杀。

sources.title: C. E. Bosworth, The New Islamic Dynasties (1996)

capital.zh: 阿米德（迪亚巴克尔），后迁大不里士

summary.en: The "White Sheep" Turkmen confederation based at Diyarbakır. Uzun Hasan destroyed the Qara Qoyunlu and ruled from Tabriz, courting Venice against the Ottomans, but lost to Mehmed II at Otlukbeli in 1473; his grandson Ismail founded the Safavid state on its ruins.
summary.zh: 以迪亚巴克尔为根据地的“白羊”土库曼部落联盟。乌宗·哈桑消灭黑羊王朝并定都大不里士，联络威尼斯对抗奥斯曼，却在1473年奥特卢克贝利之战中败于穆罕默德二世；他的外孙伊斯玛仪在其废墟上建立了萨法维国家。

sources.title: J. E. Woods, The Aqquyunlu: Clan, Confederation, Empire (rev. ed., 1999)

note: Ismail I took Tabriz in 1501; the last Aq Qoyunlu ruler, Murad, held parts of Iraq until 1508.

summary.en: After Nader Shah’s death, the Lur chieftain Karim Khan Zand restored order to most of Iran, ruling modestly as vakil ("regent") from Shiraz, which he adorned with a citadel, bazaar and mosque. Civil war after his death let the Qajars destroy the dynasty.
summary.zh: 纳迪尔沙死后，卢尔族首领卡里姆汗·赞德恢复了伊朗大部分地区的秩序，他以“摄政”（瓦基勒）自居而不称王，定都设拉子，并在城中修建城堡、巴扎和清真寺。他死后内战不断，恺加王朝最终消灭了赞德王朝。

sources.title: J. R. Perry, Karim Khan Zand: A History of Iran, 1747–1779 (1979)

name.zh: 德拉伊耶酋长国（第一沙特国）

summary.en: The first Saudi state grew from the oasis of Diriyah after Muhammad ibn Saud allied with the reformer Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab in 1744. It spread across most of Arabia, taking Mecca and Medina in 1803–05, until an Egyptian-Ottoman army razed Diriyah in 1818.
summary.zh: 第一沙特国起源于德拉伊耶绿洲。1744年穆罕默德·本·沙特与宗教改革者穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒-瓦哈卜结盟后，国家扩展到阿拉伯半岛大部，1803–1805年占领麦加和麦地那，直到1818年埃及-奥斯曼军队夷平德拉伊耶。

name.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·穆罕默德
沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹

sources.title: M. Al-Rasheed, A History of Saudi Arabia (2nd ed., 2010)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Saudi Arabia: The Wahhābī movement

note: Saudi Arabia officially dates the state to Muhammad ibn Saud’s accession in 1727 (Founding Day decree, 2022); many historians start it with the 1744 alliance.

summary.en: The eastern Georgian kingdom united by Heraclius II, who sought Russian protection in the Treaty of Georgievsk (1783). When Russia failed to defend it, Agha Mohammad Khan sacked Tbilisi in 1795; Tsar Paul I annexed the kingdom in 1801.
summary.zh: 赫拉克利乌斯二世统一的东格鲁吉亚王国，他在1783年《格奥尔吉耶夫斯克条约》中寻求俄国保护。俄国未能出兵援救，1795年阿迦·穆罕默德汗洗劫第比利斯；1801年沙皇保罗一世吞并该王国。

sources.title: R. G. Suny, The Making of the Georgian Nation (2nd ed., 1994)

summary.en: A Hashemite monarchy installed by Britain under a League of Nations mandate, with Faisal I as king from 1921. It became formally independent in 1932 and was overthrown in the military revolution of 14 July 1958, when the royal family was killed.
summary.zh: 英国依据国际联盟委任统治扶植的哈希姆君主国，1921年起由费萨尔一世为王。1932年正式独立，1958年7月14日军事革命推翻君主制，王室成员遇害。

sources.title: C. Tripp, A History of Iraq (3rd ed., 2007)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Iraq: The Hashemite monarchy

note: 1921–1932 under British mandate.

capital.zh: 耶路撒冷（以色列宣布；国际地位存在争议）

summary.en: A Jewish state proclaimed in Tel Aviv on 14 May 1948 as the British mandate ended. Its founding war displaced over 700,000 Palestinian Arabs; later wars brought the West Bank, Gaza and other territories under its control, and the conflict with the Palestinians remains unresolved.
summary.zh: 1948年5月14日英国委任统治结束之际在特拉维夫宣布成立的犹太国家。建国战争使七十余万巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人流离失所；此后的战争使约旦河西岸、加沙等地落入其控制之下，与巴勒斯坦人的冲突至今未决。

name.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（总理）

sources.title: B. Morris, 1948: A History of the First Arab–Israeli War (2008)

note: Ben-Gurion’s tenure was interrupted in 1954–55; Rabin also served 1974–77 and Netanyahu 1996–99 and again from 2022.

name.en: Oman under the Al Bu Said
name.zh: 赛义德王朝治下的阿曼

capital.zh: 鲁斯塔克，后为马斯喀特

summary.en: Ahmad bin Said, elected imam after the Persian occupation of the 1740s ended, founded the dynasty that still rules Oman. From Muscat its sultans built a maritime empire reaching Zanzibar and the Swahili coast; after Said bin Sultan died in 1856 the realm split, a division fixed by the Canning Award of 1861.
summary.zh: 1740年代波斯占领结束后，艾哈迈德·本·赛义德被推举为伊玛目，建立了至今仍统治阿曼的王朝。其苏丹以马斯喀特为基地，建立起远及桑给巴尔和斯瓦希里海岸的海上帝国；1856年赛义德·本·苏尔坦去世后，国土一分为二，1861年的“坎宁裁决”确认了这一分治。

note: The founding is conventionally dated 1744, though some sources date Ahmad's election as imam to 1749. Rustaq was the early seat; Muscat became the capital under his successors in the 1780s. Zanzibar's branch is covered by the Africa dataset.
